recode_for_groupby: recode a pandas Categorical for groupby with sort and observed parameters to control category ordering
test_recode_for_groupby_observed: test recode_for_groupby with observed=True to return only observed categories in the result
test_recode_for_groupby_sort_false: test recode_for_groupby with sort=False to order categories by appearance in the data
test_recode_for_groupby_sort_true: test recode_for_groupby with sort=True to preserve sorted category order
review_recode_for_groupby: review recode_for_groupby to handle missing categories and NaN values in categorical groupby
